visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two women sit on a beige sofa behind a white table crowded with Stitch merchandise, including a large blue plush on the left and various small figurines. The woman on the left wears a blue 'BRAVES' jersey, while the woman on the right wears a cream-colored t-shirt. The room is brightly lit with a white wall background. (2) The scene transitions into a quiz format with dynamic text overlays appearing in the center. The women raise their hands and use exaggerated facial expressions, such as wide-eyed excitement and gasping, to signal their answers. Cartoon-style icons like a dog and a squirrel appear next to their heads. (3) The camera focuses on the winner, the woman in the blue jersey, who laughs and holds the large Stitch plush victoriously. Yellow comic-style impact lines radiate from her. The woman on the right looks slightly disappointed, resting her chin on her hand. (4) A series of close-up shots show the details of the merchandise: Stitch on a scooter, Stitch on a surfboard, and Stitch inside various fruit-themed bases. The lighting remains bright and studio-like, highlighting the glossy textures of the toys. (5) The woman on the right holds the large plush while a gray-scale filter and a purple rain-cloud graphic appear over her head to indicate sadness. She looks downcast while the other woman remains cheerful in the background. (6) Both women speak directly to the camera, gesturing toward the table of toys. They demonstrate how to hold the plushies. The background shows a white shelf with books and more collectibles in a home-office setting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy synthesized pop track featuring a bright synth melody and a steady 4/4 drum machine beat. A male voice with high enthusiasm introduces the game, followed immediately by a sharp digital 'whoosh' transition effect. (2) A clear digital 'ding' sound signifies the start of the first question. Two female voices respond with high-pitched, fast-paced speech. A comical 'honk' or 'buzzer' sound effect plays after an incorrect guess, followed by a triumphant fanfare and digital cheering sounds upon the correct answer. (3) During the second question, multiple speech layers overlap as the women guess movie titles. Each incorrect guess is punctuated by a short, percussive 'thud' or comical sliding whistle effect. The male 'game master' voice maintains a playful, teasing tone with varied pitch contours. (4) The third question features a slight shift in tone. When the woman expresses frustration, a low-frequency synthesized 'doom' sound and a rainy-noise texture are added. The vocal volume of the woman on the right decreases, exhibiting a comical 'moping' prosody. (5) As the focus shifts to the 7-11 promotion, the BGM remains upbeat but drops slightly in volume. The female voices speak in a synchronized, rhythmic fashion to announce dates and prices. A 'sparkle' or high-frequency digital chime plays when the '7-11' brand is mentioned. (6) The final phase features the women quoting movie lines in a softer, more sentimental tone with a gentle piano melody emerging underneath. The audio ends with a playful banter and a short comedic stinger sound.
